convert_local_to_global_order_idxs: convert local order indices to global indices using local_order_idxs_to_global with possible actions tensor
convert_global_to_local_order_idxs: convert global order indices to local indices using global_order_idxs_to_local with ignore_missing flag
convert_action_strs_to_global_idxs: convert Diplomacy action strings like A MOS B to global indices using action_strs_to_global_idxs
validate_diplomacy_action: validate a player action tuple against a pydipcc game state using is_action_valid for movement retreat or adjustment phases
canonicalize_diplomacy_action: canonicalize a Diplomacy action tuple into location-sorted order using canonicalize_action for deterministic ordering
